name: SonderMind
one_liner: Free therapist network with VA partnership (100% covered for veterans), AI matching, measurement-based care, and no-show reimbursement.
short_description: SonderMind is a free-to-join therapist network with VA partnership, AI-powered patient matching, measurement-based care emphasis, and no-show reimbursement for insured clients.
long_description: SonderMind is a mental health platform operating in all 50 states that connects therapists with clients while handling insurance credentialing, billing, and patient matching. The platform is free for providers to join—therapists work as 1099 independent contractors and receive bi-weekly payouts with same-day payment options available. A key differentiator is SonderMind's VA partnership: therapy is 100% covered for veterans with a valid referral, opening a significant patient population. SonderMind uses AI-powered therapist-patient matching and emphasizes measurement-based care with outcome tracking tools. The company offers no-show reimbursement—providers get paid when insured clients miss appointments. However, compensation ratings are mixed (2.3/5 on Comparably) with some therapists reporting lower effective rates than competitors. SonderMind is headquartered in Denver and works with major insurers including Aetna, Anthem, BCBS, Cigna, and UnitedHealthcare.
best_for: Therapists wanting to serve veterans (VA partnership with 100% coverage)
Clinicians interested in measurement-based care and outcome tracking
Therapists wanting same-day payment option (for a fee)
New clinicians seeking steady client referrals through AI matching
not_for: Clinicians building their own independent practice (credentials belong to SonderMind)
Therapists prioritizing highest compensation (2.3/5 pay rating on Comparably)
Providers wanting full transparency on revenue split
Those wanting control over payer contract negotiations
Clinicians who may want portable credentials when leaving

seo.title: SonderMind: VA Partnership & AI Matching for Therapists
seo.meta_description: SonderMind is free to join with VA partnership (100% covered for veterans), AI patient matching, no-show reimbursement. All 50 states, bi-weekly payments.

faqs.a: Yes, SonderMind is free to join with no membership fees. The platform uses a revenue-sharing model, taking a percentage of insurance reimbursements. However, the exact split isn't publicly disclosed, and compensation ratings are mixed (2.3/5 on Comparably).
SonderMind is an in-network VA provider. Therapy is 100% covered for veterans with a valid VA referral. This opens a significant patient population that many other platforms don't directly serve.
Yes, SonderMind reimburses providers when insured clients no-show or late cancel. This provides income stability that independent practice doesn't always offer.

faqs.q: How does SonderMind compare to Headway?
faqs.a: Both are free with revenue sharing. SonderMind uniquely offers VA partnership and no-show reimbursement. Headway has a larger network (70,000+ vs SonderMind's smaller network). Both have undisclosed revenue splits. Compensation reviews are mixed for both.

faqs.q: What happens if I leave SonderMind?
faqs.a: Your insurance credentials stay with SonderMind. You'd need to re-credential independently (60-120 days). This is the same credential lock-in as Headway, Grow, Alma, and Rula.

funding.context: Reached unicorn status in 2021. One of the higher-valued platforms despite 2.3/5 compensation rating.

company_info.notes: Colorado-based mental health platform with emphasis on measurement-based care and VA partnership. Tech-founded, not clinician-led. Valued at $1.1B despite compensation concerns.
